args.rationale: Diversity jurisdiction exists for Scenario 3 of the Ostrander Tooling intake letter. Sole plaintiff Ostrander Tooling Works, Inc. is an Ohio corporation with its only plant and headquarters in Canton, Ohio, so it is a citizen of Ohio. Sole defendant Quenneville Alloys Inc. is incorporated in Delaware and has its principal place of business in Louisville, Kentucky, so it is a citizen of both Delaware and Kentucky. For complete diversity, no plaintiff may share a state of citizenship with any defendant; Ostrander (Ohio) shares no citizenship with Quenneville (Delaware/Kentucky), so complete diversity is satisfied. Amount in controversy: the damages demand is $410,000 exclusive of interest and costs, which exceeds the $75,000 threshold required by the memo's diversity test. Both independent requirements (complete diversity and amount exceeding $75,000) are satisfied, so diversity jurisdiction exists.
